title: トレードさせていただきますっ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out shopping on a day off when I come across a group in a stir about something.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Three whole boxes and we still haven't got one… Urk! My stomach can't take any more…

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: King! Let's give up finding it ourselves! Any more and we're likely to get sugar poisoning!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gasp… I wouldn't dare make you suffer that for me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All right… Digital, I've decided to take you up on that trade you offered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hweee! Thank you so kindly for accepting! Or I mean, I'm really sorry to have bothered you out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No, no, you're actually helping us out. No matter how much we eat, we just can't find King's card. We're at the end of our rope.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-i-is that so? Well, I'm used to eating tons of chocolate, so just leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: When you buy mountains of chocolate like I do, you get tons of duplicates. I'm sure I'll get a few of King!
choice_data_list: What are you guys talking about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't Trainer! Hehe, we're talking about Umamusume chocolate eggs! King and her friends came here to buy some too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Umamusume chocolate eggs… Oh, it must be those egg-shaped chocolates that come with an Umamusume figure inside.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I gave them permission to use my likeness in the latest series!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A-a-about that, King! I'll check which ones I get right away and then message you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze! I can't believe I get to actually do something useful for my oshi!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Today's gonna be the unboxing of the century! No holds barred! I'll order twenty ten-egg boxes and bust all of 'em open at once!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guehehe… Drool… Looking at all the wonderful figures as I eat, this chocolate's gonna taste diviiine… ♪
choice_data_list: Try not to eat too much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hm, you're right! Putting on too much weight will interfere with my sacred races…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll keep a number of chocolates aside and eat them in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm normally happy with whoever I get, but just this time, I'm hoping for lots and lots of Kings. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital rushes home with an armful of chocolate egg boxes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Can do! I just gotta sort out some drinks that go well with chocolate now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Guehehe! Tonight, I feast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Agnes Digital heads home gasping in anticipation.
